typesense:top-rated.greeting:
At Dergin Care, we understand that majestic beasts deserve the finest care. Specializing in the grooming of large magical creatures like gryphons, dragons, and other mythical beasts, we offer a range of enchanted services to keep them looking and feeling their best.
Include:
Scale Polishing and Feather Preening
Magical Mane and Tail Treatments
Claw, Talon, and Horn Care
Healing and Relaxation Elixirs
Total Oral Hygiene checkups
Stomach, intestinal, and Sex Deep Cleaning
Rough Ride Restraints

Our team of skilled groomers is trained in handling even the most formidable of creatures with the utmost care and respect. Trust Dergin Care to provide the highest quality of magical grooming for any legendary beast. Book an appointment today and experience the difference of enchanted care!
